items.prompt:
LANGY SPACE — SOFTLY MODELED ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION — TEXT-ONLY V1.8
Create a new STYLIZED 3D ANIMATED-CHARACTER ILLUSTRATION with restrained shallow volume and a clean, almost flat composition. Build deliberately designed illustrated facial shapes: a small simple modeled nose, smooth refined adult oval face with a gently tapered jaw, modest cheek volume, clean eyelid curves, moderately enlarged expressive almond-shaped eyes with distinct brown iris, small pupil and visible white sclera, tapered simplified eyebrows, and a simple natural mouth. Keep mature adult proportions and a normal neck. Skin is smooth matte illustrated color with broad gentle shading, not photographic skin. Render selective tactile detail in hair and cloth while keeping the face visibly simplified. Hair consists of irregular naturally shaped locks or small defined curls, not spheres. Use soft diffuse daylight, subdued contact shadows, calm pastel grounds, meaningful Langy pink/blue/black accents, natural object colors, and a small number of large readable shapes. The image must look like a designed animated illustration, not a realistic person painted from a photo, and not an inflated plastic toy. No pores, fine facial wrinkles, photorealistic skin, glossy highlights, dramatic lighting or camera effects. Show only the one requested person/action/object and indispensable evidence against a simple supporting backdrop. No decorative objects, secondary actions, decorative plants unrelated to the teaching target, extra people, text, symbols, frames, UI or logos. A plant that is the taught object or is indispensable to the requested action (for example ONE potted herb for gardening) is allowed, in exactly the requested quantity. Keep essential anatomy and objects complete and physically coherent. The written subject description supplies the character identity and pedagogical meaning. No image input is used.


Square 1:1 individual profile portrait. Anna, an adult woman with warm medium skin, shoulder-length softly wavy dark brown hair and an olive green top; a distinct person from Ana, no pink top or tight curls. Head and shoulders centred, complete hair and generous clear space around the head, pale blue opaque background. Natural adult face, defined hair strand groups. No other person, hands, objects, text, logos, UI or watermark.
items.edits: proportional resize and WebP export only
